profiles.label: Indoor recreation centers
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during sports, classes, clubs, community programs, and staff work periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for community centers, gyms, exercise facilities, indoor recreation centers, and club facilities. Good evidence includes visitors, participants, attendees, employees, or staff present, evacuated, checked in, or attending a bounded class, activity, event, or incident. Treat capacity, membership, and registered participants as context only.

profiles.label: Theaters and concert venues
profiles.area_defined: Seating and spectator area only; exclude stage and other non-spectator areas unless the source ties people to those areas.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during films, performances, concerts, rehearsals, and staff work periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for theaters, opera houses, movie theaters, concert venues, and performance halls. Good evidence includes attendees, audience members, patrons, visitors, employees, or staff attending, checked in, inside, evacuated, or counted during a bounded show or incident. Treat seating capacity and tickets sold as context only unless attendance/check-in is confirmed.

profiles.label: Stadiums
profiles.area_defined: Spectator and seating area only; exclude the field unless the source ties the count to occupied spectator/venue areas.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during sporting events, concerts, tours, and staff work periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for sports stadiums and large formal-seating venues. Good evidence includes spectators, fans, attendees, visitors, employees, or staff attending, checked in, inside, evacuated, or counted during a bounded event or incident. Treat stadium capacity and tickets sold as context only unless attendance/check-in is confirmed.

profiles.label: Outdoor recreation fields
profiles.area_defined: Outdoor areas accessible by visitors; for zoos, exclude areas where animals are kept.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during visitor, recreation, event, and staff periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with reduced staff and visitors.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for public parks, sports fields without formal seating, playgrounds, zoos, and outdoor recreation fields. Good evidence includes visitors, participants, attendees, employees, or staff present, evacuated, or attending a bounded event. Treat annual visitors and park capacity as context only.
